  ctrl+c                quit, asked twice in a conversation                          enter                 open the changes, then a file

chat                                                                                 c                     commit, from the file list
  enter                 send                                                         o                     a reviewer's opinion, from the ranking
  shift+tab             plan or build, which is what the agent may change            K                     credentials
  /                     the command list, which narrows as you type                  esc                   back one level
  up / down             move the command list, or otherwise your sent history
  tab                   take the highlighted command                               a diff
  //                    send a literal prompt beginning with slash                   j / k                 scroll a line
  esc                   interrupt the turn, or clear a half written message          space                 scroll a page
  ctrl+c                stop the turn, then twice to quit                            g / G                 top and end
  ctrl+n                a new conversation, keeping this one                         esc                   back to the file list
  ctrl+d                agents, and it works with a question waiting here
  ctrl+k                credentials                                                writing a commit
  ctrl+r                compact the conversation, asked twice because it spends      ctrl+s                commit. nothing is staged until then
  ctrl+o                show tool output and diffs in full, and fold them back       esc                   cancel, throwing the message away
  pgup / pgdown         scroll the conversation, or the btw panel while it is up
  mouse drag            select conversation text, copied when you let go           worktrees
  ctrl+home / ctrl+end  the top, and back to following                               j / k                 move
  alt+enter             a line break instead of sending                              g / G                 top and end, as do home and end
  ctrl+f                find in the conversation; enter older, down newer            r                     refresh
  ctrl+y                copy the last code block, or the last reply                  K                     credentials
  enter / y             allow a tool call once, while a question is up               esc / tab / q         agents
  a                     allow it for the rest of the session
  arrows / pgup         read on with a question up, deciding nothing               the model picker, on /model
  any other key         refuse it                                                    j / k                 move, across credentials as well as within one
